proposed_record.reviewerRationale: Invest Ottawa is already published, and its current public defence innovation hub page adds useful, source-backed program context without changing the organization identity. The page frames Canada’s National Defence Innovation Hub as an Ottawa-Gatineau strategy and implementation effort linking government, academia, industry and investors around defence innovation, testing infrastructure, procurement pathways, workforce capacity and allied landing opportunities. This candidate adds a nested program and updates profile metadata only. Reviewers should verify whether future modeling should introduce a separate hub or task-force organization, and should avoid treating the strategy as procurement eligibility, endorsement, customer interest or classified demand.

fieldEvidence.excerpt: The Invest Ottawa hub page presents Canada’s National Defence Innovation Hub and a five-year Ottawa-Gatineau strategy for coordinating government, academia, industry and investors around defence innovation.
The page states that an Ottawa-Gatineau Defence Innovation Hub Task Force will lead implementation, coordinate actions, identify funding, track progress and report annually on outcomes.

The strategy highlights priorities to unite the ecosystem, expand test infrastructure, attract investment, help companies grow, build workforce capacity and position Ottawa-Gatineau for allied defence and dual-use technology firms.
